source: JPL Horizons API vectors, CENTER=500@301, ICRF, geometric, 5-min step; rotated to MOON_ME with NAIF moon_pa_de421_1900-2050.bpc + moon_080317.tf via Skyfield
horizons_span_note: Tag-up w/data through November 10, prediction thereafter.
prediction_after: 2026-11-10 (Horizons header: tag-up data through Nov 10, prediction thereafter)

definitions.pass: Danuri centre above the site's horizon mask (terrain mask if web/data/horizon/<ID>.json exists, else flat 0 deg), observer 2 m above terrain; edges linearly interpolated between 5-min samples
definitions.relay_upper_bound: share of the site's no-direct-Earth time (Earth centre below the mask) during which Danuri is above the site's mask AND Earth's centre is not blocked by the lunar sphere as seen from Danuri

caveat: Danuri carries no lander relay payload. relay_upper_bound is a GEOMETRIC upper bound only (no link budget, scheduling, pointing or payload). It shows what an orbiter like Danuri could cover, not a service that exists.
